name: Apprentice Kj
desc:
Apprentice Kj is an Etrean NPC. He is a student under [Evengarde Rest](entity:evengarde_rest) at the [Isle of Vigils](location:isle_of_vigils) and the brother of [Vigil Isaac](entity:vigil_isaac).

Completing his dialogue starts the "Vigil's Savior" Quest.

Apprentice Kj wears the Cloak of Winds outfit along with a White Deepwoken Cloak.
